clients.name: NightMail
clients.description: NightMail client: public, authorization code + PKCE (S256), response_mode=query. Redirects: nightmail://auth-callback (macOS/iOS/Android), http://localhost:34571 exactly (Windows/Linux), <web origin>/callback.html (web).

clients.name: Nightware dev/test client
clients.description: DEV ONLY. Confidential client with the password grant, so scripts (smoke.sh, integration tests) can get a user token without a browser. Tokens look like NightMail's (aud nightware-api).

clients.name: Nightware Graph API
clients.description: The façade. Resource server for NightMail tokens (aud nightware-api); confidential client that exchanges inbound user tokens (RFC 8693) for tokens audienced to stalwart / nextcloud; service account for Keycloak admin-API directory lookups.

clients.name: Stalwart Mail Server
clients.description: Audience-only client: Stalwart's OIDC directory accepts tokens with aud=stalwart (acceptedAudiences). No flows enabled.

clients.name: Nextcloud
clients.description: Nextcloud user_oidc provider client. Browser login to Nextcloud, and the audience Nextcloud requires on bearer tokens (CalDAV/CardDAV/WebDAV/OCS).
